title: Books & Stories

expressions.example: It's time to turn the page and move on.

expressions.expr: Judge a book by its cover
expressions.example: Don't judge a book by its cover.
This novel is such a page-turner.
You have to read between the lines to understand it.

sentences: The author who wrote this novel is Brazilian.
This is the book that changed my life.
The character who I liked most was the villain.
The story, which was published last year, became a bestseller.
The library that I visit is downtown.
The plot, which was very complex, kept me curious.
I met the author who wrote my favorite novel.
This is the chapter that surprised me the most.

grammar.title: Relative Clauses — Who / Which / That
rules: "Who" se refere a pessoas: The author who wrote this novel is Brazilian.
"Which" se refere a coisas, geralmente com vírgulas (informação extra): The story, which was published last year, became a bestseller.
"That" pode substituir "who" ou "which" em orações restritivas (sem vírgula): This is the book that changed my life.
